text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—The girl who took on the MC rotation last 
year won the NHK Mile Cup, but I wonder 
how Tanino Gimlet will fare~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I really want a clean victory, of course. 
And then take the Derby too! ...Or so I'd 
like to say, but hmm.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
“—I wonder if Gimlet's okay... I just 
really hope she doesn't get injured or 
anything before the Derby—”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...The hell?! You're all just saying 
whatever you want...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If it's Gim-senpai, I just know she'll 
blow away all our worries with an 
incredible run...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right before the race, Tanino Gimlet 
harbored a stillness that she had never 
shown before...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —At last.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I've finally reached the stage where I 
can unleash everything I am without 
holding back...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? Right now, I find it 
terrifyingly—comforting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In every single one of those words dwelt a 
fierce, terrifying intensity of will.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing the race she had aimed for all 
along, she was... ecstatic.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Which is precisely why, right now. 
Trainer. I'm going to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If I remain just as I am— I probably won't 
be able to win this race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was a sudden bout of weakness, words 
quite uncharacteristic of Tanino Gimlet."
choice_data_list: Out of the blue, why would you—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...My intuition tells me that is the case. 
And it has for some time now.
choice_data_list:
Could that possibly be... about fate and 
destiny...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, it is quite close. However, what 
makes this different from before is—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"It means that I have no intention of 
accepting this fate...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, it's the opposite! I shall 
passionately embrace this sensation as an 
ordeal to adorn me, turn it all into 
brilliance, and destroy it completely!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Remember this. When I seize victory in 
this NHK Mile Cup, it will mean—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Our running shone brightly enough to 
shatter the very chains of fate!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. The one who has trained me and 
stood by my side to this day—is you, and 
only you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, my running does not belong to 
me alone. It is the radiance of both you 
and me!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it is time. Let us be off.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Look closely and behold. How I stand 
before the face of destiny—
